name: Fieldwork
summary: Fix screen wake-lock leak, keep complementary number text readable, and harden saved settings.
changes: Reuse active or pending wake-lock requests and release locks that arrive after a session has ended.
Background-complement number text keeps its hue but is darkened or lightened to at least 3:1 contrast when the pure complement is hard to read.
Ignore saved settings that no longer match an available option instead of stalling the countdown.
Number color test runs from a plain repository checkout as well as dist/.
